spanish: Y cuando peregrinare contigo peregrino en su tierra, no lo oprimirán.

findings.issue: The land suffix is 2nd masculine plural. “su” is the ustedes possessive, and it can also be read as the sojourner’s land.

notes: contigo matches the 2ms suffix; oprimirán is ustedes for the 2mp hiphil; lo matches the 3ms object.
